user_prompt: Hey, my boss missed the meeting this morning. Can you summarize the notes so he knows what we decided? Keep it short.
final_prompt:
Hey, my boss missed the meeting this morning. Can you summarize the notes so he knows what we decided? Keep it short.

<document>
Ops sync, notes (rough)
attendees: priya, tom, wen, me

- tom recapped the Q3 numbers again, nothing new
- long tangent about the office coffee machine (broken again)
- scheduling software: we compared Vendor A ($24,000/yr) and Vendor B ($18,500/yr).
  wen is worried about B's support hours but B has the hospital integrations we need.
  DECISION: go with Vendor B
- budget approved at $18,500 for year one
- priya owns the rollout. go-live deadline is Nov 22
- tom will ask if A can match the price, probably won't matter
- next sync moved to thursday
- reminder: submit timesheets
</document>
